revisionDesc.change: Finalized - This is good to go.

Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Looks pretty good. i.3 ἀτηρέμα >> ἀτρέμα; i.4 I prefer |reg| tags (so also in i.15, i.22, ii.5); i.13 ἐστήρι[ξε] >> ἐστήρι<ξε> and use |ed| instead of |subst| tags; i.14 use separate square brackets; remove square brackets at end of i.17; in i.22 I think we need |ed| tags (<:<:τ’|reg|τὰ:> <:ἐπήδων|reg|πήδων:>=pap.|ed|τ’ ἐπήδων=mss.:>); remove the underdot in i.24's |reg| tags; add iota adscript in i.30; add whitespace in ii.1 and correct dots; correct ii.3 (<:ἔλεξ’ |reg|ἔλεξε:>; correct square bracket at end of ii.5; dot the first tau in ii.11; fix accent in ii.12 and add @resp; dot the final eta of ii.18; dots are missing in ii.19; add enclitic accent at end of ii.21; replace the |corr| with |ed| tags in ii.22; swap the |ed| tag values in ii.23; dot the last mu in ii.28; commentary suggests |reg| in ii.30, and I would do the same in ii.31; dot the gamma in ii.32. Revise metadata before finalization.
Submit - Encoded as part of coursework for C.M. Sampson at the University of Manitoba. Metadata has not been updated.
